judger.general.fileNameTemplate.descript:
Filename template for new files created via Competitive Companion. When set, overrides Use Short CodeForces/AtCoder/Luogu Name.

Placeholders:
{name}: problem name
{index}: problem index (e.g. A, B, C)
{slug}: sanitized name (words joined by _)
{group}: contest/group name
{url}: full problem URL
{ext}: file extension (e.g. cpp, py)
{lang}: language name (e.g. cpp, python)
{contestId}: contest ID from URL
{problemId}: problem ID from URL
{oj}: OJ abbreviation (CF, AT, LG, Kattis, CC, etc.)
{ojName}: OJ full name (Codeforces, AtCoder, etc.)

Example: {oj}/{contestId}/{problemId}_{slug}.{ext}
For per-OJ overrides, use File Name Template Overrides.
judger.general.fileNameTemplateOverrides:
Per-OJ filename template overrides. Keys are OJ abbreviations (e.g. CF, AT, LG, HDU). Falls back to File Name Template if no match.

Example: { "CF": "{contestId}{problemId}.{ext}", "AT": "{contestId}{problemId}.{ext}", "LG": "{oj}/{problemId}.{ext}" }

judger.general.collectProblemsInRoot.des: Save all problem metadata (.cph) in the workspace root directory instead of alongside each source file. Keeps subdirectories clean when using filename templates with paths.
judger.general.ojMapping.description: Custom OJ hostname to metadata mapping. Keys are hostnames (e.g. 'www.luogu.com.cn'), values are objects with {oj, ojName, contestIdRegex?, problemIdRegex?, problemSource?}. problemSource is 'vjudge' or 'original' and overrides Default Problem Source for this OJ. Matched URLs override built-in detection. Example: { "my.oj.cn": { "oj": "MYOJ", "ojName": "My OJ", "problemSource": "original" } }
judger.general.defaultProblemSource.desc: Problem page source used when an OJ mapping does not specify one. Select VJudge or Original OJ.
judger.general.vjudgeOjNames.description: VJudge OJ name to original URL mapping. Keys are OJ names as they appear in VJudge URLs (e.g. 'CodeForces', '51Nod'), values are {urlTemplate, problemIdRegex?, compositeFormat?, vjudgeUrlKey?}. Used to reconstruct original OJ URLs for filename templates and submission. compositeFormat controls how to rebuild the composite problem ID (default: '{contestId}{problemId}'). vjudgeUrlKey overrides the OJ name used when constructing VJudge URLs from other sources (e.g. 'CF' → 'CodeForces'). Example: { "51Nod": { "urlTemplate": "https://www.51nod.com/Challenge/Problem.html#problemId={problemId}" } }
